\
```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
path <- getwd()
setwd(path)
source("utils.R")
load("adult_nhis_data.RData")
```
ARTHGLUPEV: *"Have you EVER been told by a doctor or other health professional that you had some form of arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, lupus, or fibromyalgia (fy-bro-my-AL-jeeuh)?"*\
```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
acu_arth <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  filter(ACUYR == 2, ARTHGLUPEV == 2) |> 
  summarise(count = n())
  # 229 people who answered yes to ACUYR and ARTHGLUPEV

arth_df <- adult_nhis_data |> 
  select(ARTHGLUPEV)

ggplot(arth_df, aes(factor(ARTHGLUPEV, levels = c(1, 2, 7, 8, 9)))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#CCABDE", color = "#423747", stat = "count", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    "Response to ARTHGLUPEV", 
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c(
      "1" = "No", 
      "2" = "Yes", 
      "7" = "Refused", 
      "8" = "Not Ascertained", 
      "9" = "Don't Know"
    )
  ) + 
  labs(
    x = "Response to ARTHGLUPEV", 
    y = "Count", 
 #    title = "Have you EVER been told by a doctor or other health professional that you had
 # \nSome form of arthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, lupus, or fibromyalgia (fy-bro-my-AL-jeeuh)?"
  ) + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
    axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15, unit = 'pt'))
  )
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
adult_arth_yes <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ARTHGLUPEV, 2)
adult_arth_no <- getCount(adult_nhis_data, adult_nhis_data$ARTHGLUPEV, 1)

arth_yes_per <- round((adult_arth_yes/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)
arth_no_per <- round((adult_arth_no/nrow(adult_nhis_data))*100, 2)
```

Yes: `r adult_arth_yes` (`r arth_yes_per`%)\
No: `r adult_arth_no` (`r arth_no_per`%)\
